message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV data and processes it without any schema checks, dtype assertions, null/missing value guards, or value-range validations.
No detected untrusted source handling: There is no checksum verification, pinned revision, signed URL, or authentication when fetching the BERT model or any other remote resource.

No detected label flipping detection: The code reads labels directly from the CSV and converts them to floats without any distribution checks, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a pretrained BERT model via HuggingFace Transformers without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned model revision to verify integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: The code reads labels directly from CSV and converts them to floats with no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard PyTorch training with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation of a held-out test set, no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; only roc_curve and auc are imported but no protective mechanisms are implemented.
No detected input sanitization: The code truncates long token sequences but performs no shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inputs on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validations applied to the model's output logits or predictions before they are returned.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text input, there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented anywhere in the visible code.
